# Jan-Marlon Leibl

> Jan-Marlon Leibl is a software developer from Bremen, Germany. He is building Finny, an app that keeps receipts, purchase details and warranty dates in one place.

## About

- Name: Jan-Marlon Leibl
- Location: Bremen, Germany
- Role: Software Developer
- Website: https://itsjan.dev
- Email: hi@itsjan.dev
- Languages: German and English

## Work

- Jan finished a three-year software development apprenticeship at team neusta in Bremen from 2023 to 2026.
- He mainly works with PHP, TypeScript, React, Next.js, and TYPO3.
- He started coding at age 11 after seeing a friend build a small C# app.

## Projects

- [Finny](https://fnny.app): Keeps receipts, purchase details and warranty dates together, then sends a reminder before a warranty expires.
- [Ventry](https://ventry.host): Shares files through links that expire and remove the file automatically.

## Technologies

PHP, TypeScript, React, Next.js, TYPO3, Symfony, Git, Docker, Cloudflare, Tailwind CSS, Bun, and AI-assisted development tools.
